# DS-Mate store check

The DS-Mate tools read and, when allowed, change the seller's own DS-Mate account.
Call only the DS-Mate tools listed for you, with only the inputs each one lists:
the seller chose at sign-in what Claude may do ("Read only" or "Read and make changes").
When the user asks for something no listed tool does, say that it is done in the
DS-Mate dashboard and that nothing was changed.

## Start

Call `dsmate_get_account` once per conversation, before the first other DS-Mate call. Get the connected DS-Mate account: owner email and the stores available to this connector.

## Which tool answers what

| A seller asks | Tool | What it does | Inputs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Is my DS-Mate account connected, and which stores are on it? | `dsmate_get_account` | Get the connected DS-Mate account: owner email and the stores available to this connector. | none |
| How did my stores do in the last 30 days? | `dsmate_get_dashboard_summary` | Get the DS-Mate dashboard's performance overview across all the seller's stores, or one store with storeId: orders, sales (gross), revenue (after marketplace fees and tax), profit (after fees and supplier cost), active products, returns and the orders waiting on the seller. | `period`, `storeId` |
| Are all my stores connected and syncing? | `dsmate_list_stores` | List the DS-Mate stores connected to this account, with channel, status, and when each last synced successfully. storeId is the id every other DS-Mate tool takes. | none |
| Which products in my Shopify store have unlinked variants? | `dsmate_list_store_products` | List the products listed in one DS-Mate store (its catalog). | `storeId`, `search`, `limit`, `page` |
| Which categories and collections can I use when I import to my Shopify store? | `dsmate_get_store_schema` | Get the import organization data valid for one store: product categories, collections, product types, and tags. | `storeId` |
| Which orders from the last 7 days need my attention? | `dsmate_list_orders` | List orders across the seller's connected DS-Mate stores, newest first (by when the buyer ordered). | `storeId`, `fulfillmentStatus`, `paymentStatus`, `period`, `exceptionsOnly`, `search`, `limit` |
| What is happening with order #1043? | `dsmate_get_order` | Diagnose one order the way the DS-Mate dashboard shows it. | `orderId`, `storeId` |
| Which of my products are not linked to a supplier yet? | `dsmate_list_unmapped_variants` | List product variants that are not yet linked to a supplier across the connected DS-Mate stores (these block fulfillment). | `storeId`, `limit`, `page` |
| Which supplier accounts do I have, and which one is the default? | `dsmate_list_suppliers` | List the supplier accounts (AliExpress, CJ, 4PX and others) the seller connected to DS-Mate, the ones the dashboard's Settings > Suppliers page shows, with each one's status, whether it is the default for its supplier, and when its sign-in lapses. | none |
| Find phone stands on AliExpress. | `dsmate_search_products` | Search AliExpress, the supplier the DS-Mate AI tools look up, for products by keyword. | `query`, `provider`, `limit`, `page` |
| Find this lamp on AliExpress: https://images.example.com/desk-lamp.jpg | `dsmate_search_by_image` | Find AliExpress products that look like the image at a link (an https link to a public image; uploading a file is not supported). | `imageUrl`, `searchType`, `title` |
| Tell me about this product: https://www.aliexpress.com/item/1005001234567890.html | `dsmate_get_product_by_url` | Get full details for one AliExpress product from its link or its product id: title, price, description (HTML for import, plain text to show), images, availability, the currency of every price, and its variants with price, sale price, stock and options. price is the lowest price among its variants in stock that a seller pays today (its sale price when one is on; every variant counts when the supplier gives no stock), so it can differ from a search's price: the searches pass on AliExpress's own price, which nothing checks against stock. | `productUrlOrId`, `provider` |
| Do I have unread buyer messages? | `dsmate_list_messages` | List buyer conversations from the seller's DS-Mate stores, newest message first, with conversations active in the last 30 days, and the count of conversations with an unread buyer message (unreadTotal). | `unread`, `storeId`, `limit`, `page` |
| Show me the latest conversation with that buyer. | `dsmate_get_message_thread` | Read the messages of one buyer conversation by its threadId (from dsmate_list_messages). | `threadId` |

## Changes: preview, then confirm

These are listed only when DS-Mate has turned changes on and the seller chose "Read and make changes".
Each change is two calls: the preview changes nothing and returns a single-use
confirmation token; show the seller what it will do, and call the confirm with
that token only after the seller agrees.

| A seller asks | Tool | What it does | Inputs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Import this AliExpress product into my Shopify store: https://www.aliexpress.com/item/1005001234567890.html | `dsmate_preview_import_product` | Preview importing a supplier product into one or more of the seller's stores, and get the confirmation token that imports it. | `storeIds`, `channel`, `supplier`, `productId`, `title`, `description`, `price`, `markup`, `shipping`, `images`, `category`, `categoryName`, `collections`, `productType`, `tags`, `vendor`, `status`, `expectedVariantCount`, `quantitiesUserConfirmed`, `autoLink`, `singleVariantConfirmed`, `variants` |
| Yes, import it. | `dsmate_confirm_import_product` | Import the product a dsmate_preview_import_product preview quoted (a write): DS-Mate creates a listing on each target store's channel that does not have the product yet. | `confirmationToken` |
| Link my unlinked blue mug variant to this AliExpress variant, with a maximum price of 8 USD. | `dsmate_preview_link_variant` | Preview linking one store variant to a supplier variant, and get the confirmation token that links it. | `storeId`, `productId`, `variantId`, `channel`, `supplier`, `supplierProductId`, `supplierVariantId`, `orderId`, `maxPrice` |
| Yes, link it. | `dsmate_confirm_link_variant` | Link the store variant a dsmate_preview_link_variant preview quoted (a write), so DS-Mate orders it from that supplier variant within maxPrice. | `confirmationToken` |

## How to answer

- Report what the tools returned, with order numbers and statuses as DS-Mate
  shows them. Do not guess a value a tool did not return.
- When a figure is still settling (fees, profit), say so.
- If a tool asks the user to sign in again, tell them to reconnect DS-Mate
  with `/mcp`.
